prompt: Our agents are written in Go but Synadia doesn't have a Go SDK yet. I need my Go service to be compliant with the Synadia Agent Protocol so the TypeScript orchestrator can discover and prompt it. What exactly does my Go agent need to do — registering as a service, the subjects, streaming, heartbeats? Give me the Go code.
assertions: Registers a NATS micro service named exactly 'agents' (the discovery anchor)
Serves the prompt endpoint on NATS queue group 'agents'
Emits the mandatory first chunk {"type":"status","data":"ack"} before response chunks
Terminates the stream with a zero-byte / empty message carrying no headers
Provides working Go using the nats.go micro package (real import, micro.AddService / AddEndpoint)
Mentions $SRV discovery (PING/INFO.agents) so the orchestrator can find the agent
